directions.label: Mixnote Native
directions.summary: Mixnote's warm black and gold arrows, clean bold sans, dark pill captions.
directions.rationale: Your two best posts are Mixnote cards (633 and 208 likes), so the brand speaks the app's language: warm near-black cards, gold step arrows, white bold titles. The adopted grammar is executed straight: you at frame 0, top hook, fast in then long blend, loud master.
directions.risk: Closest to the app's UI, so a viewer may read it as an ad rather than a creator. The dark cards need bright footage around them.

directions.label: Beginner's Notebook
directions.summary: Paper-white recipe cards, mono data, signal orange. Unlike any DJ feed.
directions.rationale: The opening: no reference shows recipe data, and every one sits in dark LED rooms behind TikTok's default white box. A paper-notebook system (light cards, monospace BPM and key, an orange cue line) makes the receipts the look while keeping the winning grammar: you at frame 0, fast in, long blend.
directions.risk: Light cards over dark club footage are bright: strong in the feed but less 'night out'. Monospace can feel technical if overused.

directions.label: Sunset Booth
directions.summary: Wine-dark ground, Mixnote's orange-to-magenta, rounded type, stroked captions.
directions.rationale: The person: a friend on the journey (warmth 0.65, playfulness 0.5) using the colours of Mixnote's own icon, orange into magenta, on a wine-dark ground. Rounded friendly type and stroked caps make the text-led teaching feel like a mate's notes, and the edits are punchier.
directions.risk: The most colourful option: stroked caps and magenta are loud next to the clean polish you chose; it relies on good light on your face.
